name: Release
tagline: Package, version, and gate every artifact for deployment with automated approval workflows and zero-risk rollback strategies.
summary: You mastered the Release stage—from automated semantic versioning and changelog generation to approval gates, feature flags, and blue/green deployment readiness validation.

curriculum.title: Semantic Versioning (SemVer) & Release Numbering
curriculum.description: Master the Major.Minor.Patch versioning contract that communicates breaking changes, new features, and bug fixes to downstream consumers of your software.
objectives: Apply the SemVer contract: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH and pre-release identifiers (1.0.0-beta.1)
Use pre-release versions (`alpha`, `beta`, `rc`) for internal testing gates
Understand when API contract changes require a MAJOR version bump

curriculum.title: Automated Release with semantic-release & Changelogs
curriculum.description: Eliminate human error from release versioning by fully automating version determination and CHANGELOG generation using `semantic-release` driven by Conventional Commits.
objectives: Configure `release.config.js` with changelog, git, npm, and GitHub plugins
Automate CHANGELOG.md generation from `feat:` and `fix:` commit messages
Set up dry-run mode to preview release notes before publishing to production

curriculum.title: Approval Gates & Change Advisory Board (CAB) Workflows
curriculum.description: Implement regulated human approval checkpoints within CI/CD pipelines to satisfy enterprise governance, SOX compliance, and CAB requirements before production deployments.
objectives: Configure GitHub Environments with mandatory reviewer approval before prod deployment
Integrate Jira Change Management tickets as pipeline pre-conditions
Design approval escalation workflows for critical production releases

curriculum.title: Feature Flags & Controlled Feature Rollout
curriculum.description: Decouple feature deployment from feature release. Ship dark code to 100% of infrastructure but activate features only for specific user segments using feature toggles.
objectives: Integrate LaunchDarkly or OpenFeature SDK for runtime feature toggle evaluation
Define targeting rules for progressive rollout: 1% → 10% → 50% → 100% of users
Implement kill switches that can disable features within 30 seconds without redeployment

curriculum.title: Release Notes & Stakeholder Communication Automation
curriculum.description: Automatically generate rich release notes from PR descriptions and push them to Slack, email, and the company internal changelog portal.
objectives: Configure GitHub Release Drafter to auto-compose PR-sourced release notes
Push formatted release summaries to engineering Slack channels via webhooks
Maintain a public-facing customer changelog synced with every production release

learningPath.title: Understand SemVer Contracts and Pre-release Identifiers
learningPath.description: Master the semantic versioning rules and understand when to use `alpha`, `beta`, and `rc` designators.
learningPath.keyTakeaway: SemVer is a communication protocol between software producers and consumers—break it, break trust.

learningPath.title: Configure semantic-release for Automated Version Bumping
learningPath.description: Wire `semantic-release` into GitHub Actions to auto-bump versions, tag git commits, and publish Docker images on every merge to main.
learningPath.keyTakeaway: Remove human hands from version management to eliminate inconsistency and release day errors.

learningPath.title: Set Up GitHub Environment Approval Gates
learningPath.description: Create `staging` and `production` GitHub Environments with designated approvers who must manually authorize releases before the pipeline proceeds.
learningPath.keyTakeaway: Approval gates provide human oversight for high-risk production deployments while keeping automation for staging.

learningPath.title: Implement Feature Flags for Progressive Rollout
learningPath.description: Integrate OpenFeature SDK and configure percentage-based targeting rules for the new checkout redesign feature.
learningPath.keyTakeaway: Feature flags let you separate the risk of deploying code from the risk of activating a feature.

learningPath.title: Automate Release Notes to Slack & GitHub Releases
learningPath.description: Configure GitHub Release Drafter to compile PR titles and descriptions into formatted release notes automatically on every merge.
learningPath.keyTakeaway: Stakeholders should know what's in every production release without interrogating developers.

quiz.question: According to Semantic Versioning, when should the MAJOR version number be incremented?
options: When fixing a minor CSS bug in the dashboard
When adding a new optional API endpoint that does not affect existing integrations
When introducing backwards-incompatible API changes that will break existing clients
On every calendar month, regardless of what changed
quiz.explanation: MAJOR version bumps signal breaking API changes. Consumers who depend on your `v1.x.x` API must proactively upgrade their integration when you release `v2.0.0`. This is a contract between the software producer and all downstream consumers.

quiz.question: What is the key advantage of using Feature Flags to roll out new features instead of deploying them to all users at once?
options: Feature flags eliminate the need for any automated testing
Feature flags allow you to ship code to 100% of infrastructure but gradually activate it for 1% → 10% → 100% of users, enabling instant rollback without a new deployment
Feature flags make web applications load 10x faster automatically
Feature flags replace the need for a CI/CD pipeline entirely
quiz.explanation: Feature flags decouple deployment (code going to servers) from release (users seeing the feature). This allows gradual percentage rollouts and instant kill switch activation—all without creating a new Docker build or redeployment.

handsOnLabs.title: Automated semantic-release Configuration Lab
handsOnLabs.prerequisites: GitHub repository with Conventional Commits enabled from the Code phase.
handsOnLabs.desc: Wire `semantic-release` into a GitHub Actions workflow that automatically determines the next semantic version from commit history, creates a GitHub Release, and pushes a Docker image tag.
objectives: Initialize `semantic-release` with `@semantic-release/git`, `@semantic-release/changelog`, and `@semantic-release/github` plugins
Configure `release.config.js` specifying main and beta release branches
Trigger a dry-run release to preview the auto-generated CHANGELOG
Verify that `feat:` commits trigger a Minor bump and `fix:` triggers a Patch bump

handsOnLabs.title: Feature Flag Progressive Rollout Lab
handsOnLabs.prerequisites: React or Node.js project and a free OpenFeature or Flagsmith account.
handsOnLabs.desc: Implement a runtime feature flag system that activates a new checkout UI redesign for a controlled percentage of users. Configure targeting rules and practice immediate kill switch activation.
objectives: Integrate `@openfeature/react-sdk` and configure a Flagsmith provider
Wrap the new `<CheckoutV2 />` component with a feature flag evaluation `useFlag('checkout-v2')`
Configure a 10% percentage rollout targeting rule for the `checkout-v2` flag
Simulate an incident by instantly disabling the flag without redeploying
